original.target_description: Kosson, Lorenz, and Newman (2006), published article, primary criminal-conduct analysis: ASPD-only versus control, number of charges for violent offenses, European American incarcerated men; pairwise group test after antisocial-behavior outlier exclusions (not the severe-ASPD supplementary analysis).

n.sample_role: Analytic participants (incarcerated European American men), separately reported for the two comparison groups.
n.exclusions: From 472 inmates with complete classification and antisocial-behavior information: univariate outliers excluded were 3 ASPD + PSY, 4 ASPD-only, and 7 controls; multivariate outliers excluded were 1 ASPD-only and 1 control. Study eligibility excluded thought disorder, psychotropic medication, achievement below fourth grade, and estimated IQ below 70.

replication.target_description: Comparison of number of violent charges for ASPD-only diagnosis versus controls. Adult male county-jail inmates in Illinois; standard diagnostic groups; pairwise criminal-history test, not severe-ASPD sensitivity analysis.

n.sample_role: Participants in each comparison group, respectively: ASPD-only; control. Group sizes are printed separately; not a derived combined n.
n.exclusions: Paper p. 334 excludes neurocognitive medication effects, psychotic symptoms, inability to read English, estimated IQ below 70, and missing prior-charge information. Left-handedness exclusion applies only to cognitive analyses. P. 335: criminal-analysis outliers in 12 controls, 9 ASPD-only and 4 ASPD + PSY were transformed, not removed.
